SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_018") FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1."XCL_022" = T2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_006" = 'Blue' AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Brown' AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
AND T4."XCL_011" = (SELECT MAX(T6."XCL_011") FROM hero_attribute AS T6 INNER JOIN attribute AS T7 ON T6."XCL_010" = T7."XCL_003" WHERE T7."XCL_004" = 'Strength')
